title: 2 new full scholarships: Oxford's Clarendon and Belgium's VLIR-UOS
text: Clarendon pays full fees and a living grant for any Oxford master's or DPhil, open to every nationality, and you are considered when you apply for your course. VLIR-UOS ICP Connect scholarships fully fund a bachelor's or master's in Flanders for nationals of 25 countries in Africa, Asia and Latin America; the 2027–28 call is expected to open by the end of October.

title: Australia: 6 funded routes and a country guide
text: Australia Awards Scholarships, the Australian Government's Research Training Program, and research scholarships at the University of Melbourne, the University of Sydney, the University of Queensland and ANU, with a guide to Australian student visas, proof of funds, work rights and the Temporary Graduate visa.

title: 8 new routes in Africa and Asia
text: Japan's MEXT scholarship, Korea's GKS, the KAUST Fellowship in Saudi Arabia and the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship, plus Mastercard Foundation Scholars at the University of Cape Town, Ashesi University in Ghana, the AIMS master's and the African Union's Pan African University.

title: Deadlines and amounts updated across the board
text: New dates for Helsinki (5–19 January 2027), MIT (4 January), Dartmouth (1 January), the Canadian doctoral awards (19 October) and Mastercard Foundation Scholars at Cambridge. Maastricht's renamed NL-High Potential scholarship now pays €20,150 in living costs for a 13-month programme. Eiffel, Hungary and Türkiye show their 2027 calls as expected.

title: 8 new funded PhD posts at Uppsala University
text: Peace and conflict research, limnology, laser spectroscopy, developmental psychology, nuclear physics, organic chemistry, bioinformatics and perovskite solar cells, all salaried and open to every nationality.

title: Nobel Peace Prize 2026: Navi Pillay
text: Awarded to the South African judge and former UN human rights chief for her efforts to promote peace and international law.

title: NASA's next step on the LISA telescope
text: The final pre-flight test telescope for LISA, the ESA-led space observatory for gravitational waves due to launch in the mid-2030s.

title: Nobel Prize in Literature 2026: Anne Carson
text: Awarded to the Canadian poet and classicist for work in playful dialogue with the classical tradition that has created new forms for contemporary literature.

title: Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2026: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai
text: Awarded for discovering how chemical reactions can produce mostly, or only, one of a molecule's two mirror-image forms.

title: Nobel Prize in Physics 2026: Francis Halzen
text: Awarded for the IceCube Neutrino Observatory at the South Pole and the discovery of high-energy neutrinos from beyond the solar system.

title: Two new guides for applicants from any country
text: Visa money, work hours and staying after graduation compared across ten countries, and how funded PhDs work in Europe: salaried posts, doctoral fellowships and scholarships, with a checklist for reading a PhD advert.

title: New: research and innovation news
text: A new page on the year's major research prizes and new funding, from the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine and the Fields Medals to the Kavli and Breakthrough Prizes.

title: New: funded PhD and research positions
text: A new page lists salaried PhD posts, doctoral fellowships and postdocs at Lund, Uppsala, Oslo, Copenhagen and ETH Zurich.

title: Country guides: visa money, work rights and staying after graduation
text: For all ten countries: the proof of funds for a student visa, the hours you may work, and how long you can stay to look for a job.

title: New route: Bowdoin College (USA)
text: Need-blind admission for international applicants, with 100% of calculated need met and no loans. Early Decision 1 closes on 15 November; Early Decision 2 and Regular Decision close on 5 January.

title: New route: Danish Government Scholarships
text: Tuition waivers and grants towards living costs for highly qualified non-EU/EEA students on full degree programmes. Each Danish university selects its own scholars and sets its own dates.

title: DAAD: doctoral rate in the EPOS call
text: DAAD's EPOS call lists €1,400 a month for doctoral candidates from February 2026, up from €1,300. Its general scholarship overview still lists €1,300.

title: TU Wien: non-EU application windows
text: The winter semester 2026/27 window for non-EU/EEA applicants closed on 15 July 2026. The summer semester 2027 window runs from 16 July 2026 to 15 January 2027.

title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars at ASU: 2027–28 call closed
text: Applications for the 2027–28 cohort closed on 27 September 2026 at 23:59 GMT.
